patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Genesys and Wati share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Genesys and Wati share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Genesys only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CCaaS (Genesys Cloud CX) — CX 1 from $75/user/mo annual; CX 2 $115; CX 3 $155; ” rather than Wati's shape. Choose Wati only if your buying job matches “Official WhatsApp Business API platform with a shared team inbox, broadcasts, chatbots and” rather than Genesys's shape. Workflow advantage: Genesys leans contact-center, sales-calling; Wati leans whatsapp-support, customer-follow-up. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Genesys and Wati share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Genesys is Enterprise CCaaS (Genesys Cloud CX) — CX 1 from $75/user/mo annual; CX 2 $115; CX 3 $155; CX 4 $240.; Wati is Official WhatsApp Business API platform with a shared team inbox, broadcasts, chatbots and AI co-pilot — platform subscription (Growth/Pro/B.
- Company-size focus: Genesys (mid-market, enterprise) vs Wati (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Genesys-leaning contact-center, sales-calling vs Wati-leaning whatsapp-support, customer-follow-up, lead-nurturing.
- Researched limits: Genesys — Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone; Wati — Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country.

Limitations — Genesys: Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone; CX 1 is voice-only; digital channels require CX 2 or digital add-ons; Wati: Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country; Growth includes 3 users and does not allow additional users at all.
